summary_en: Daito Pharmaceutical initiated a share buyback program to acquire up to 1.25 million shares (4.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 2 billion yen from October 15, 2026 to May 21, 2027 via open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with planned cancellation on May 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice on Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 14, 2026, Daito Pharmaceutical's Board of Directors resolved to initiate a treasury share acquisition program. The company will acquire up to 1.25 million shares of its own common stock, representing 4.4% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total consideration of 2 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 15, 2026 through May 21, 2027.

Following the acquisition period, all 1.25 million shares will be cancelled effective May 31, 2027. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 500,718 treasury shares (excluding 94,340 shares held in trust for the executive share grant program) out of 28,354,162 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

The company stated that this buyback program is part of its medium-term management plan capital strategy, aimed at strengthening shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency.
